items.title: Const Takes Over Synth (SN50), Ties Miner Rewards Directly to Live Trading Profits
items.body: Const takes over Synth, tying miner rewards to profits from live trades based on their price forecasts. Trading revenue will flow back into the subnet.

items.title: Score (SN44) Launches yuBot, an AI Assistant Powered by Bittensor Subnets
items.body: Score launches yuBot, an open-source AI assistant that brings specialised Bittensor subnet services together through one interface for everyday users.

items.title: It’s AI (SN32) Launches a Dual Competition for AI Detection and Humanisation
items.body: It’s AI (SN32) splits emissions 50/50 between AI detection and humanisation, turning the battle to identify and rewrite AI text into a dual miner competition.

items.title: OpenRoboto (SN80) Secures 50,000-Hour Robotics Data Deal, Begins Gamma Buybacks
items.body: OpenRoboto secures a 50,000-hour robotics data deal and completes its first Gamma buyback and burn, bringing monthly token burns above $19,000.
